description: This file contains implementation of string utility functions for handling string interpolation, edit distance calculations, spellchecking, and reading from stdin, specific to the 'gn' build system component.

methods.name: ErrInsideStringToken
methods.description: Constructs an error indicating a range inside a string token, adjusting for quotes.

methods.name: AppendInterpolatedExpression
methods.description: Parses and evaluates an expression inside string interpolation, supporting identifiers and accessors.

methods.name: AppendInterpolatedIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a value from scope for a given identifier and appends its string representation.

methods.name: AppendStringInterpolation
methods.description: Handles string interpolation for $identifier and ${expression} formats.

methods.name: AppendHexByte
methods.description: Parses a hex byte literal in string interpolation and appends its character equivalent.

methods.name: ExpandStringLiteral
methods.description: Expands a string literal with interpolation, handling escape sequences and embedded expressions.

methods.name: EditDistance
methods.description: Computes the Levenshtein distance between two strings with an early cutoff.

methods.name: SpellcheckString
methods.description: Finds the closest matching word within a maximum edit distance for spellchecking.

methods.name: ReadStdin
methods.description: Reads all data from stdin into a string.
